William Alves, born on October 4, 1991, is a Brazilian professional football player who primarily plays as a central defender. He started his professional career with Brazilian club Sport Recife in 2010 and quickly established himself as a solid defender.

Alves made a name for himself in Brazil before moving to Japan to play for Júbilo Iwata in 2015. During his time with the J-League club, he gained valuable experience and showcased his defensive abilities.

In 2017, Alves returned to Brazil to join Internacional but later moved to South Korea to play for Suwon Samsung Bluewings. He continued to excel and impressed with his performances in the K-League.

Throughout his career, William Alves has been praised for his strength, aerial ability, and solid defensive skills. He is known for his leadership qualities on the field and his ability to organize the defense effectively.

Overall, William Alves is a talented and experienced central defender who has proven himself in various leagues around the world.
